subject.title: Make adaptive refresh agent-aware on fresh installs

question: Should Adaptive authorize local process and transcript-metadata scanning for existing Adaptive users and become the fresh-install default, or must agent-aware scanning remain separately authorized?
rationale: Current behavior defines Adaptive as an opt-in menu, power, and thermal cadence, while this PR changes both its data-observation semantics and fresh-install default; tests cannot determine the intended consent and rollout policy.

options.title: Keep scanning separately authorized
options.body: Preserve existing Adaptive users' menu-only behavior and add an explicit or versioned new-install authorization before enabling local activity scans.

options.title: Approve the expanded contract
options.body: Explicitly accept scanning for all Adaptive users and the fresh-install default, with upgrade disclosure and packaged runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Keep current behavior until broader battery, privacy, and multi-machine evidence supports a default change.

recommendation.title: Keep scanning separately authorized
recommendation.body: Preserve existing Adaptive users' menu-only behavior and add an explicit or versioned new-install authorization before enabling local activity scans.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently calibrated the Agent Sessions scanner and its default-off product boundary.
